nodes.label: Setup Prerequisites (Claude Code, Python, Bun, LaTeX)
nodes.rationale: CV compiles with lualatex because pdflatex often fails on modern MiKTeX with fontawesome5 font-expansion errors; the cover letter needs xelatex because cover.cls requires fontspec for its bundled Lato/Raleway fonts.

nodes.label: Minimal TeX Install (TinyTeX/BasicTeX) Package Set
nodes.rationale: Minimal distributions need moderncv, fontawesome5/6, academicons, import, luatexbase, pgf, titlesec, textpos, xltxtra, xunicode, cite, realscripts and needspace before the stock templates compile; a user-level TinyTeX install on macOS avoids sudo.

nodes.label: Basic MiKTeX Silent Auto-Install Configuration
nodes.rationale: MiKTeX's default on-demand install pops a GUI prompt per package, which blocks non-interactive terminals including Claude Code's Bash tool; initexmf --set-config-value=[MPM]AutoInstall=1 turns it silent, or pre-install the package set with mpm for fully offline compiles.

nodes.label: pdftotext as an Optional Dependency
nodes.rationale: poppler's pdftotext is not part of any TeX distribution, so /apply degrades gracefully: if it is missing the mechanical ATS check is skipped with a warning and falls back to a visual keyword review.

nodes.label: /setup Onboarding Paths A/B/C
nodes.rationale: Path A reads the documents folder and cross-references multiple sources, Path B imports a single CV with follow-up questions, Path C is a structured interview. All three produce identical fully populated profile files; --section allows targeted re-runs.

nodes.label: Pulling Upstream Updates Into Your Fork
nodes.rationale: Commit personalization first because an uncommitted tree is the most common reason git pull refuses to merge; preview with check_upstream_updates.py; then three-way merge. A conflict in a personalized file is a feature, not a failure - it means upstream changed methodology in a section you customized, and the version marker plus changelog commit explain why.

nodes.label: Optional Salary Benchmarking Setup
nodes.rationale: Entirely optional step: create salary_data.json by hand or convert an Excel sheet with tools/convert_salary_excel.py. Skipping it simply omits the salary lookup from /apply.

nodes.label: Stale .claude/settings.local.json From an Older Clone
nodes.rationale: Earlier versions committed a broad settings.local.json pre-approving Bash(curl:*), Bash(python:*) and Bash(bun:*). Git leaves that untracked file behind on old clones and its permissions still apply on top of the narrow settings.json, so it must be deleted or trimmed.
